description: Build unsigned non-custodial CROSS-CHAIN bridge and swap calldata via LI.FI Diamond moving an ERC-20 or native token from `from_network` to a DIFFERENT destination `to_network` (settling in `USDC`, `USDT`, or destination `NATIVE` gas across `base`, `arbitrum`, `optimism`, `polygon`, `ethereum`, `bsc`, `linea`, `avalanche`). Read-only calldata builder: does not sign or broadcast transactions (unlimited free calls; includes a 1.00% atomic integrator fee). Returns JSON with `from_network`, `to_network`, `approve_tx`, `bridge_tx`, `estimated_out_usd`, and `execution_duration_sec`. Use this tool only when bridging across two DIFFERENT networks; use `build_evm_dust_to_usdt_sweep` for same-chain swaps.

amount_in_raw.description: Input token amount in atomic base units (wei integer formatted as a decimal string, e.g. `10000000` for 10 USDC).

from_network.description: Source EVM chain where the token currently resides (must differ from `to_network`).

sender.description: 42-character hexadecimal EVM wallet address (`0x...`) initiating the bridge on `from_network` and receiving funds on `to_network`.

target_stable.description: Output asset on `to_network`: `USDC`, `USDT`, or `NATIVE` (for emergency cross-chain gas refuel). Defaults to `USDC`.

to_network.description: Destination EVM chain to receive the bridged stablecoin or native gas. Defaults to `base`.

token_in.description: 42-character hexadecimal ERC-20 token contract address (`0x...`) on `from_network` (or `0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000` for native gas).

name: build_cross_chain_consolidation
